name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2025-04-28, at wavelengths from 1.14 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
